assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 changes the metrics port (PR #6578); the release note does not state the previous or new port value, nor the flag or setting that carries the port.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The note says only 'Change metrics port'; it does not state whether the port is set by a CLI flag, Helm value, or config key, nor which component owns it, so no family-exact subject identity can be spelled from this evidence.; applicability: The previous and new port values are not stated, and whether an environment is exposed depends on external metric-scraping configuration (e.g., a Prometheus scrape target on the old port) that this release note does not describe, so no environment predicate can be built from this evidence.; consequence: The release note does not state what happens in an exposed environment (e.g., whether scrapes against the previous port fail or whether the port is migrated automatically by the chart), so no consequence kind can be asserted.
